additional_info.subject: ID0473043-DC/Si-D/DE- [] Session Interruptions CRM:03056000957
additional_info.body:
Dear Marius,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
Following your report, and after checking the logs, we have concluded that the charging session stopped multiple times, because of Converter 14, related to the CanCommLoss cable.
Regarding this problem, we see that this error is not appearing anymore, and this could have been a bug in the moment.
If there would be a problem related to the converter, or the CanCommLoss cable, this would show in the error flags, which it doesn`t.
We will monitor the charger for the next three days, to see if the issue occurs again.
We hope to have informed you enough.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum

additional_info.subject: ID0473043-DC/Si-D/DE- [] Session Interruptions CRM:03056000957
additional_info.body:
Dear Marius,
Following your request, we have monitored the charger for the past three days.
No errors or faults appeared and the charger looks healthy and stable.
This means the problem is resolved and we will close the ticket after receiving your feedback.
If any issues appear again in the future, don`t hesitate to contact us again.
We hope to have informed you enough.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
